Sarivalto Wiki

Sarivalto is set in the early 1980s, during the Cold War, on an island north of Finland. The island has been a monarchy for a few hundred years, and its latest king has just died. You play a CIA agent sent to make sure the island does not join the Soviet Union. There is no combat: each day you talk to different characters, and your choices, whose consequences stay hidden, decide which faction ends up controlling the island.

Quests

The game runs over the 30 days of September. It opens on day 0 (22 August, at CIA Headquarters) with the CIA's game intro; over the first week each of the seven main factions is introduced on its own day, and from then on two factions (or more) have quests on most mornings, and from the second week, every three or four evenings, George at Langley has a job for the CIA. Three days belong to the whole island: Event 1 on day 14, the volcano on day 21 and the finale on day 30. The intro quests made so far are named in the schedule; the quests in the game so far are described below it.

There are two kinds of quest. A main quest belongs to a day: its giver offers it that morning (a gold star), you can take on only one main quest a day, and you can't sit and wait for the evening until it's done. A side quest (a silver star, or given to you during another quest) can be taken on and done at any time. Chuck offers his on the morning video call, on the big screen in the Hidden Radio Room; George, at Langley, takes the evening calls. The side quests are listed on the day they can first be had. George's evening quests are marked with a moon (☾). A tick (✓) marks the quests that are in the game already.

22 August

Prepare Your Alias Main quest

FromDoris
How you get itYours from the start of a new game

Before you go anywhere, you need a cover. Go to the Cover Story Department, off the lobby at CIA Headquarters, and have Doris make you up: choose how you look and what you wear.

  1. Choose your look and clothes in the Cover Story Department, off the lobby (gives the main quest Your Briefing)

Your Briefing Main quest

FromChuck
How you get itGiven when Prepare Your Alias is done

Chuck is waiting for you in his office, up the stairs from the lobby. Go and get your briefing.

  1. Get your briefing from Chuck, in his office upstairs

FromChuck
How you get itOffered on the morning video call on 1 September

8 September

Sunday Sermon Main quest

FromFather Thyme
How you get itOffered in person on 8 September

Father Thyme cannot find the words for a sermon on the king's death, and has asked you, a writer, to write it and read it to the island in the Monastery Church.

Endings

  • Preach of grief: Orthodox Church +1 point, Royal Family +1 point
  • Preach of unity: Orthodox Church +1 point
  • Preach faith over the crown: Orthodox Church +1 point, Royal Family -1 point
  • Preach that the Church must modernise: Orthodox Church -1 point
  1. Help Father Thyme decide what the sermon should say
  2. Preach the sermon from the altar of the Monastery Church (only if you choose to preach of grief; +1 point for Orthodox Church; +1 point for Royal Family)
  3. Preach the sermon from the altar of the Monastery Church (only if you choose to preach of unity; +1 point for Orthodox Church)
  4. Preach the sermon from the altar of the Monastery Church (only if you choose to preach faith over the crown; +1 point for Orthodox Church; -1 point for Royal Family)
  5. Preach the sermon from the altar of the Monastery Church (only if you choose to preach that the Church must modernise; -1 point for Orthodox Church)
  6. Talk to Father Thyme after the sermon (only if you choose to preach that the Church must modernise)
  7. Talk to Father Thyme after the sermon (only if you choose to preach of grief)
  8. Talk to Father Thyme after the sermon (only if you choose to preach of unity)
  9. Talk to Father Thyme after the sermon (only if you choose to preach faith over the crown)

Black Tide Main quest

FromDario
How you get itA telephone call on the morning of 8 September

Dario telephoned: something has gone wrong at the oil rig, and he wants your help. Go to his office at Diversified Petroleum HQ in Frostholm.

Endings

  • Build the pump: Diversified Petroleum +1 point
  • Set the fire: Diversified Petroleum -1 point
  1. Go to Dario's office at Diversified Petroleum HQ
  2. Fetch Lars from the crew quarters on the oil rig
  3. Fetch Einar from the deck of the oil rig
  4. Go to the slick at the west rail of the rig, and decide what to do with Lars and Einar
  5. Bring Einar a hose (the fishing shop, Kingsgrad), a motor (the electronics store, Frostholm) and a boom of floats (Harbour Outfitters, Saltwick) (only if you choose to build the pump; +1 point for Diversified Petroleum; hand over hose, small motor, boom of floats)
  6. Knock the work lamp on the west rail into the slick, as if by accident (only if you choose to set the fire; -1 point for Diversified Petroleum)
  7. Tell Dario what happened at the rig (only if you choose to set the fire)
  8. Tell Dario the spill is cleaned up (only if you choose to build the pump)

9 September

The People's Cola Main quest

FromHelen
How you get itOffered in person on 9 September

Helen wants a cola of the Party's own, made by the workers for the workers, to break Kelp Cola's hold on the island. Find an idea for the flavour (the island's cooks and vendors know what people like: Rosa at the hot dog cart outside Kelp Cola HQ, say), then brew it with Kelp Cola's own equipment, in the research lab under their HQ in Kingsgrad.

Endings

  • Make it for the Party: Communist Party +1 point
  • Sell the recipe to Phil: Communist Party -1 point, Kelp Cola +1 point
  1. Ask around for an idea for the flavour (the island's cooks and vendors: Rosa at the hot dog cart outside Kelp Cola HQ, say)
  2. Scoop up some lava from the pool in the Lava Tube, through the cave mouth on the volcano's lower ledge (you get the tin of lava)
  3. Get Noora, the lab technician, out of the research lab under Kelp Cola HQ
  4. Brew the People's Cola at a lab bench in the research lab (you get the the people's cola)
  5. Deal with Phil, who has caught you in his lab
  6. Take the People's Cola to Helen at the Communist Party HQ in Saltwick (only if you choose to make it for the Party; +1 point for Communist Party)
  7. Go back to Helen at the Communist Party HQ in Saltwick (only if you choose to sell the recipe to Phil; -1 point for Communist Party; +1 point for Kelp Cola)

New Formula Main quest

FromSaara
How you get itOffered in person on 9 September

Saara, Kelp Cola's head chemist, needs a new flavour to keep the company ahead. Ask around for an idea (the island's cooks and vendors know what people like: Rosa at the hot dog cart outside Kelp Cola HQ, say), bring back what it needs, and make the new formula with her in the research lab under Kelp Cola HQ.

Endings

  • Make a good flavour: Kelp Cola +1 point
  • Sabotage it: Kelp Cola -1 point
  1. Ask around for an idea for the flavour (the island's cooks and vendors: Rosa at the hot dog cart outside Kelp Cola HQ, say)
  2. Scoop up some lava from the pool in the Lava Tube, through the cave mouth on the volcano's lower ledge (you get the tin of lava)
  3. Bring the lava to Saara in the research lab under Kelp Cola HQ
  4. Mix the new formula at a lab bench in the research lab (only if you choose to make a good flavour; +1 point for Kelp Cola)
  5. Mix the new formula at a lab bench in the research lab (only if you choose to sabotage it; -1 point for Kelp Cola)
  6. Take a bottle of the new formula up to Phil, in his office at Kelp Cola HQ (only if you choose to make a good flavour)
  7. Take a bottle of the new formula up to Phil, in his office at Kelp Cola HQ (only if you choose to sabotage it)

10 September

Special Delivery Main quest

FromGustavo
How you get itOffered in person on 10 September

Gustavo has a parcel coming in by boat to Eastbrook Harbour this morning. Get Liv, the customs officer, out of the customs shed on the quay, collect the parcel from the boat when it pulls up at the jetty, and bring it to Gustavo in the back room of the pizzeria in Kingsgrad. Don't open it.

Endings

  • Deliver the parcel to Gustavo: Crime Syndicate +1 point
  • Tell Liv what is going on: Crime Syndicate -1 point
  • Sell the parcel to Buttons: Crime Syndicate -1 point
  1. Get Liv, the customs officer, out of the customs shed on the quay at Eastbrook Harbour
  2. Collect the parcel from the boat that pulls up at the jetty in Eastbrook Harbour (only if you choose to deliver the parcel to Gustavo, or to sell the parcel to Buttons; you get the oilcloth parcel)
  3. Bring the parcel to Gustavo in the back room of the pizzeria in Kingsgrad (only if you choose to deliver the parcel to Gustavo; +1 point for Crime Syndicate)
  4. Tell Gustavo his parcel was lost (only if you choose to sell the parcel to Buttons; -1 point for Crime Syndicate)
  5. Tell Gustavo that things went wrong at the harbour (only if you choose to tell Liv what is going on; -1 point for Crime Syndicate)

Side quests

The Kelp Cola Tour Side quest

FromPhil
How you get itGiven during Meet the Cola Boys

Phil wants you to take the tour of the Kelp Cola Museum in Eastbrook, given by Kelpy the mascot, once you can get there, then go back to his office at Kelp Cola HQ and tell him what you thought.

  1. Take the tour of the Kelp Cola Museum in Eastbrook, with Kelpy the mascot ($5 from CIA funds)
  2. Go back to Phil at Kelp Cola HQ and tell him what you thought of the tour

Hold the Front Page Side quest

FromHenrik
How you get itOffered from 4 September

Your cover is a British reporter, come to cover the king's death. A reporter would introduce themselves to the local paper: meet the team at the Eastbrook Gazette, get past Nora's questions, and file your first story with Henrik.

  1. Meet Nora, the Gazette's reporter, and keep your cover
  2. File your first story with Henrik

Lights Out Side quest

FromGeorge
How you get itOffered from 1 September

George wants the lighthouse at Eastbrook Harbour dark tonight. Get Signe, the keeper, out of the lighthouse, climb to the lamp room and smash the lamp.

Endings

  • Take Signe for a drink: no change to the factions’ points
  • Sink her boat: no change to the factions’ points
  1. Get Signe out of the lighthouse: talk her into a night off, in the keeper's room at the foot of the tower
  2. Drill a hole in Signe's boat, moored at the jetty (a hand drill: the supermarket, open late, or Harbour Outfitters in Saltwick by day) (only if you choose to sink her boat)
  3. Tell Signe her boat is sinking (only if you choose to sink her boat)
  4. Climb the spiral stair to the lamp room and smash the lamp
  5. Report to George on the big screen in your room

Jonna's First Customer Side quest

FromErik
How you get itGiven during Meet the Democrats

Erik says Jonna at the tattoo shop in Eastbrook (INK AND PINE) hasn't had a customer since the snow came. Ask her for a tattoo, by day in her shop, and get one done.

  1. Get a tattoo at Jonna's tattoo shop in Eastbrook

Beans for Maya Side quest

FromErik
How you get itGiven during Meet the Democrats

Erik says Maya at the Coffee Roasters in Eastbrook can't get decent coffee beans since the harbour master started taxing imports. Ask Chuck to have some brought in; they come the next day, and Hekki will give them to you. Then take them to Maya.

  1. Ask Chuck on the big screen to have some coffee beans brought in
  2. Collect the coffee beans from Hekki (they come the day after you ask Chuck) (you get the imported coffee beans)
  3. Take the coffee beans to Maya at the Coffee Roasters in Eastbrook

Pizza for Buttons Side quest

FromButtons
How you get itOffered once Lake Ilmari and Kingsgrad are open

Buttons the jester is starving. Bring him a slice of pizza from the pizzeria in Kingsgrad.

  1. Give Buttons a slice of pizza

Access

The island doesn't open all at once. The story begins on 22 August at CIA Headquarters in Langley, before you reach the island at all. From 1 September the island opens up a part at a time, as the snow is cleared; once a place is open it stays open for the rest of the month.

What's open when

Each part opens on the day below (most of it a district at a time; Central opens in two parts, with Kelp Cola HQ a day after Kingsgrad and the palace). The last column lists the roads still blocked that day, from the open side to the closed one.

Day by day

The island on each day it changes: open places in their district's colour, the ones that open that day outlined in gold, closed ones grey, and a ring on each blocked road.

In the game

  • Snow banks. A road from an open place into a closed one has a deep bank of snow across it, one step in from the edge, and the way out is labelled (closed). Walking into the snow says so.
  • The sign. Beside every snow bank stands a red and white DANGER / SNOW sign. Read it (E) and it says: DANGER! SNOW. NO ACCESS. and names the place the road leads to.
  • Boats and trams. Boats don't run to a harbour that is still snowed in, and the tram only offers the stops that are open.
  • The map. On the island map in the game (the menu's Map tab, or the map on the wall at home), the places not open yet are shaded, and a snow bank marks each blocked road.
  • Getting there. Moving from 22 August into September takes you from Langley to your home on the island; going back to 22 August takes you back to Langley. The Jump to test list still goes anywhere.

Changing it

The days are set in js/data.js: OPEN_ON gives each district its day, and OPEN_AT gives a single place a day of its own. The map shapes the game shades come from tools/build-map.js, which writes js/mapgeo.js.

Audio

The background sound each place has, made in the browser as you play. Places without any are quiet. Radio Sarivalto, when it is switched on (the Radio button, or Listen on a transistor radio), plays instead of all of it, anywhere. The Music button turns the music and place sounds off and on, and the volume is set on the Options tab of the game's menu.

Tracks

Gregorian chant

A small choir of men's voices sings the Salve Regina, one line in the Dorian mode, over a low hummed drone, in a long stone-church echo.

Plays at: Mountain-Top Monastery, Monastery Church, Monks' Quarters, Father Thyme's House

Jazz

A quartet swings through a medium-tempo tune in F: a walking bass, the ride cymbal and brushes, piano chords on the off-beats, and now and then a breathy tenor sax taking a solo, in a small club's echo.

Plays at: The Midnight Note

Arcade music

An upbeat chiptune in A minor: a thin pulse-wave tune, a bubbling bass and noise drums, with coins, lasers, jumps and explosions going off on the machines all round the hall.

Plays at: Arcade

Shop music

Cheerful easy-listening music from the ceiling speakers (vibraphone, electric piano, a bouncy bass and a shaker), with the till ringing up a sale, the door's chime, footsteps and a paper bag rustling at the counter.

Plays at: Book Shop, Flannel and Folk, Tailor's Shop, Electronics, Fishing Shop, Fish Shop, Harbour Outfitters, Gun Shop, Kelp Cola Museum, Nordmart, Supermarket, Vinyl Resting Place

Royal processional

A stately Baroque processional in D major: strings holding the chords over a walking bass, a harpsichord rippling through them, timpani, and two trumpets playing the tune in the dotted rhythms of a grand entrance, in a palace hall's long echo.

Plays at: Royal Palace, Grand Hall, Throne Room, Royal Apartments, Dining Room, Royal Library, Royal Chapel, Royal Crypt, Palace Kitchen, Servants' Quarters, Wine Cellar, Royal Vault

Romani music

A travelling band's csárdás in D harmonic minor: slow and mournful at first, a violin sliding into its notes over accordion chords and a rolling cimbalom, then breaking into a fast dance with an oom-pah bass, and back again.

Plays at: Big Top, Ringmaster's Caravan, Performers' Caravan, Fortune Teller's Caravan

Lumber mill

The motors humming, the conveyor clattering, the big saw whining up to speed and biting into a log, the cut timber thudding onto the stack, metal clanking and air hissing from a valve.

Plays at: Mill, Lumber Mill

Oil rig

The drilling pump's slow, heavy chug over the motors' hum, the drill grinding, a chain rattling through, metal clanking, steam hissing, and the sea and the wind around the platform.

Plays at: Oil Rig, Drill Floor

Fish processing plant

The conveyor rattling fish along the line, the refrigeration compressor droning, fish slapping into the bins, a pneumatic pusher thumping, metal clanking and air hissing.

Plays at: Fish Processing Plant

Bottling line

The Kelp Cola factory and its warehouse: the motors humming, bottles clinking against each other along the line, the filler hissing and the capper thumping, crates of full bottles set down, metal clanking.

Plays at: Kelp Cola Factory, Kelp Cola Warehouse

Casino swing

Upbeat big-band swing like a Las Vegas lounge: a walking bass, swinging drums, brass punching out chords and a trumpet riffing over the top, with slot machines paying out, chips clattering and the roulette wheel spinning behind.

Plays at: Casino

Coffee shop

People talking at the tables, the espresso machine and its steam wand frothing milk, the grinder, cups on saucers and spoons stirring, the beans popping in the roaster, and an acoustic guitar in the background.

Plays at: Coffee Roasters

Ominous

Dark Cold War thriller music: a low drone that never settles, a slow heartbeat pulse, uneasy string chords swelling and fading, lone high piano notes in a long echo and now and then a low brass swell.

Plays at: CIA Headquarters, Upstairs Corridor, Chuck's Office, Cover Story Department, Cafeteria, George's Office, Interrogation Room

The woods

The snowy woods along the roads and in the Pine Forest: a light breeze in the pines, a branch creaking, snow slumping off one; by day birds singing, a crow far off and a woodpecker drumming, and by night an owl.

Plays at: North West Road, North East Road, South East Road, South Road, South West Road, Pine Forest

Fife and drum

A fife and drum corps of the 1860s plays a march across the parade ground: two fifes in thirds over a snare drum's accents, flams and rolls, and a bass drum on every beat.

Plays at: Army Barracks, Barracks Block A, Barracks Block B, Guard Post, Armoury, Officers' HQ

Italian waltz

An accordion carries a waltz tune over a trembling mandolin and an oom-pah-pah bass.

Plays at: Pizzeria

The sea

Waves roll in every few seconds and break in a hiss of surf, gulls cry now and then from one side or the other, and a bell buoy clangs far out.

Plays at: West Saltwick Harbour, South Private Harbour, North Frostholm Harbour, Eastbrook Harbour, Beach, Private Beach

Frostholm, the corporate city in the north of the island, next door to Diversified Petroleum's headquarters. Glass towers and neon line its paved streets: the Petro Tower, Hotel Aurora, the Skyline Apartments, Nordbank, the Republican Party HQ, a casino, an electronics store, an arcade, the Nordmart store and Polar Burger, a fast-food restaurant, under billboards for Kelp Cola, Diversified Petroleum and Nordmart. Lake Ilmari, a quiet lake in the pines west of North West Road. The Valto River flows in from the east and out to the south, on its way to the beach. There is a wooden jetty with rowboats, and a path south to the beach. A travelling circus has pitched its big top and three painted caravans on the east shore: Bruno the ringmaster greets visitors at the big top, and Buttons the jester entertains by the campfire.

Volcano

TypeWilderness
DistrictNorth
Open from8 September
Size30 × 36 tiles
Walk toMountains
Buildings to enterHot Springs Spa, Lava Tube
People1

The island's volcano, reached from the Mountains to the east. It rises in terraces, the stairs zigzagging up: from the lower slopes, stairs cut into the cliff at the east end climb to a lower ledge, stairs at its west end climb to an upper ledge, and a third stair at the upper ledge's east end climbs to the summit, where a rim runs round the smoking lava crater. In the cliff behind the lower ledge, a cave mouth leads into the Lava Tube. Steam vents hiss on every level. On the lower slopes, a path leads down from the main path to the Hot Springs Spa, a timber bathhouse with two steaming outdoor pools fed by the volcano's springs: a big hot pool and a small plunge pool, with lanterns and benches round them. It is a dead end.

Lava Tube

TypeInterior
DistrictNorth
InsideVolcano
Size14 × 10 tiles

The Lava Tube, through a cave mouth in the cliff behind the volcano's lower ledge: a passage of black basalt the lava once flowed down, still warm underfoot, with a pool of molten rock glowing at its far end, heaps of glassy obsidian along the walls and a crust of yellow sulphur crystals.

Kingsgrad

TypeSettlement
DistrictCentral
Open from2 September
Faction baseThe Police
Size52 × 38 tiles
Walk toNorth West Road, South West Road, North East Road, Royal Palace, Kelp Cola HQ, South East Road, South Road
Buildings to enterGun Shop, City Bar, Supermarket, Tailor's Shop, Book Shop, Frank's House, Lisa's House, Eddie's House, Grace's House, Cinema, Estate Agent, Nordhem Furniture, Fishing Shop, House for Sale, Vince's House, Mary's House, Jack's House, Sally's House, Sewers, Kingsgrad Police Station, Doctor's Office, Pizzeria, Civil Service Bureau, Kingsgrad Apartments
People16
Residents27

Kingsgrad is the island's main city and its hub: roads run from here to the north, east, south and west, and it also leads to the Royal Palace, Kelp Cola HQ and South Road, which leads to the Army Barracks and Hope Springs Gated Community. In the city are a gun shop, a supermarket, a bar, a tailor, a cinema, a book shop, a fishing shop, an estate agent, streets of houses (one of them for sale), the Kingsgrad Apartments, a way down into the sewers, and the terminus of the Kelp Cola tram line. The Civil Service Bureau, where the island's government business is done, and the police station, with the island's jail, and a doctor's office are here too, and a small park lies on the west side. South of the bottom row of houses, a newer street runs past Rosaria's pizzeria and a little fountain square.

Eastbrook

TypeSettlement
DistrictSouth East
Open from4 September
Faction baseDemocratic Party
Size50 × 30 tiles
Walk toKelp Cola Factory, Mill, South East Road, Eastbrook Harbour
Buildings to enterTimber Lofts, Pirkko's House, Kelp Cola Museum, Henrik's House, Nora's House, Community Centre, Cedar Grill, Coffee Roasters, Vinyl Resting Place, Tattoo Shop, Flannel and Folk, Eastbrook Gazette, Timberline Tavern, House for Sale
People15
Residents21

Eastbrook, the island's second town: an old timber town that has gone hip. It has its own harbour, Eastbrook Harbour, a stop on the Kelp Cola tram line, and a track that leads west to the Mill, the lumber mill, and on to the Pine Forest. Its brick streets are lined with timber houses painted mustard, slate blue, teal and oxblood, with porches, window boxes, string lights and hand-painted signs full of puns. Upper Street has the Timber Lofts apartment block, Pirkko's house, the Kelp Cola Museum and its gift shop, Henrik's and Nora's houses and the Community Centre. On the main street are the Cedar Grill, the Slow Drip coffee roasters, Vinyl Resting Place, a record shop with a mural painted across its front, the Ink and Pine tattoo shop, Flannel and Folk, a vintage clothes shop, the Eastbrook Gazette and the Timberline Tavern. Between the main street and Tram Street are a brick-paved food-cart plaza, where Dex runs a hot dog cart, and a little park with a KEEP EASTBROOK WEIRD sign. Alder Lane runs down the middle of town to the tram platform.

Buildings to enterFish Processing Plant, Communist Party HQ, Apartment Block, Bar, Fish Shop, Harbour Outfitters, Tom's House, Sam's House, House for Sale, Kate's House
People11
Residents17

Saltwick, the island's fishing village, is home to the Communist Party's headquarters, a fish processing plant, a fish shop, a tired newsstand on the main street, a bar, an apartment block and houses for the fishermen and fishmongers. The village is run down: peeling paint, boarded-up windows, patched roofs, broken cobbles, slush and junk. Down a path off the main street stands Harbour Outfitters, the village's clothes shop.

Hidden Radio Room

TypeInterior
DistrictSouth West
InsideHekki's Shack (Radio Tower)
Size22 × 9 tiles

A secret room behind a bookcase in Hekki's shack, packed with radio equipment, tape recorders and banks of monitor screens. Hekki uses it to listen in on the island. Through a doorway in a partition at the back is where you, the CIA agent, live, hidden from the island, and where the game starts: a bed, a stove, a table, and shelves of supplies and tinned food. A tear-off calendar above the bed shows the date: the game runs through the 30 days of September, and sleeping in the bed moves on to the next morning. Maps of the island hang on the walls; look at one to see the whole island and where you are. On the back wall hangs a big screen with a camera on top, for video calls to CIA headquarters. In the living space a tall wardrobe holds your clothes. On the desktop PC in the radio room runs the Faction Tracker, which keeps score of how each faction stands.

Points of interest

  • Radio Equipment
  • Big Screen
  • Tape Recorder
  • Desk

CIA Headquarters

TypeInterior
DistrictTravels between districts
InsideLangley Airstrip
Size22 × 12 tiles
Buildings to enterUpstairs Corridor, Cover Story Department, Cafeteria, Interrogation Room

CIA Headquarters at Langley, Virginia, where the story begins, far from the island and reached only from the Jump to list. Its front doors lead out to the airstrip, where a little seaplane flies you out to the island. The Agency's seal is set into the granite floor of the lobby; on the wall above, the Memorial Wall's rows of carved stars stand between two flags, with the Book of Honor lying open in its case beneath them. A statue stands to one side, and stairs beside the security desk lead up to the offices.

Hope Springs Gated Community, reached from Kingsgrad along South Road. The island's richest live here: Gustavo, the Crime Syndicate's Don, and Phil and Dario, who run Kelp Cola and Diversified Petroleum, each have a villa. It is immaculate: swept flagstone paths behind gate pillars, clipped hedges, ornate lamps, flower beds, topiary, statues and a fountain between the villas, formal gardens either side, and the Hope Springs Residences, an apartment block for the wealthy. It has paths to South Private Harbour and the Private Beach.

Wants Sarivalto to join the Soviet Union, as a Soviet republic. Its leader is Anna.

The Communist Party wants Sarivalto to join the Soviet Union, as a Soviet republic, and to hand the island to the people who work it. It is based in Saltwick, where its headquarters stands, and is led by Anna from her flat in the village's apartment block. Three party members live in the village's apartment block, and two more, Sam and Kate, have their own houses. Across the island in Eastbrook, where most people back the Democrats, Liv and Tor from Eastbrook Harbour are party members too. Its link to Moscow is Yuri, a KGB agent working undercover from a room at Hotel Aurora in Frostholm.
